label: FACT_UNITY_3, external fact-unifier and…: Facts have constituent unity
term: fact unity, external fact-unifier and worldwise mind in #84
definition: Facts have constituent unity. An external fact-unifier is external to the selected unified fact; no formal cause, explanation or concrete bearer relation is selected. Worldwise existence allows different facts, unifiers and minds in different worlds. Capability for fact-unification differs from actual exercised fact-unification.
note: No common numerical source, unique mind, rigid necessary individual, causal adequacy or fact-to-being identity. Mind’s world-relative applicability and the de-re versus distributive scope of step6 require interpretation.
